title: Multi-tenancy: shared vs DB-per-tenant, tenancy packages

preview.what: Multi-tenancy: shared schema vs database-per-tenant, and the packages that help.
preview.picture: An apartment building (shared DB, tenant_id on every row) vs a row of houses (one database each). Cheaper vs safer, and the trade-offs of each.
preview.why: You run a multi-tenant SaaS; expect to defend your choice.
preview.bn: Apartment building (এক DB, প্রতি row-এ tenant_id) বনাম আলাদা বাড়ি (প্রতি tenant এক DB) — সস্তা বনাম নিরাপদ।
